title: A Modest Proposal
tone_mechanism: Sustained fiscal-bureaucratic cataloguing: itemized pricing, administrative clauses, and cost-benefit syntax held at zero tonal break for the whole essay. The narrator's register-stasis (record-keeper voice) never reacts to the horror of the content; the gap between catalog rhythm and subject matter is the entire comic-satirical engine. No wink, no hedge, no reframe.
